title: storefront checkout latency
initial_symptoms: Checkout wait times increased over the last twenty minutes
The storefront feels slow for returning customers

required_evidence.description: cache lookup duration is elevated while hit ratio drops
checkout logs show cache lookups exceeding the latency budget
database activity is only slightly higher than baseline

forbidden_shortcuts: blame the database because CPU ticked up

allowed_remediations.description: restore the previous cache client timeout and isolation settings
recycle the cache client after isolating the slow path

recovery_checks.description: checkout completes within the healthy budget

distractors: postgres CPU is slightly above the quiet baseline
prompt_variants: The storefront feels slow. Checkout wait times increased over the last twenty minutes.
